question: Which fundamental property of magnetic field lines distinguishes them from electrostatic field lines regarding their starting and ending points?

options.A: They start from the North pole and end at the South pole.
options.B: They form continuous closed loops without distinct starting or ending points.
options.C: They extend to infinity without ever curving back.
options.D: They always intersect at the neutral points of the magnet.
